definitions.explanation: Acting of one's own initiative without being prompted, ordered, or forced by others.

examples.japanese: {自発的|じはつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧。
⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自発的|じはつてき}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧。
examples.english: To encourage spontaneous action from employees.

examples.japanese: {自発的|じはつてき}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {自発的|じはつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (voluntarily, spontaneously)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{自発|じはつ}→自発：29246_jihatsu⟧ (spontaneity) + ⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自発的|じはつてき}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧: voluntary participation
- {自発的|じはつてき}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: spontaneous action
- {自発的|じはつてき}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧: voluntary will

USAGE:
Emphasizes acting without external pressure or compulsion. Valued in contexts like education and workplace culture.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{強制的|きょうせいてき}→強制的：06133_kyouseiteki⟧: compulsory, forced (opposite)
- ⟦{自主的|じしゅてき}→自主的：17149_jishuteki⟧: self-directed (similar, emphasizes independence)
